_note: Mission types (Logan, 2026-09-27/28). Numbers marked Proposed are Claude's starting values for tuning. rows = stops before the boss. Regular fights come from the location's encounter pools: the first weak_fights from `weak`, then `strong` (max_enemies caps a fight's size). Longer runs (Logan, 2026-09-30): Assault and Rescue 12 rows, Deep Recon 16, a refit after every 3rd row, and a repair bay every path goes through right before the boss (repair_before_boss). max_shops (Logan, 2026-09-30): at most that many autonomous bays on a map (at least one is always there); shops are a detour you choose, Slay-the-Spire style. An event stop also turns out to be a bay 10% of the time (balance.json map.event_shop_chance).

assault.name: Assault
assault.summary: A straight push to the target. Ends in a boss.

deep_recon.name: Deep Recon
deep_recon.summary: A longer route. Regular enemies are lighter, elites are tougher, and there's no boss: finishing it disables the next boss's weapons for its first turn.

rescue.name: Rescue
rescue.summary: Get in and out fast: the Alert level rises with every turn spent fighting, and higher Alert makes every fight harder. Ends in a boss.

training.name: Training
training.summary: Two short fights with a salvage and a refit between them. Doesn't count toward your record.
